install.title: Install Town Basket.
install.body: Add it to your home screen to reorder in a tap and get order updates.
install.iosStepShare: Tap the Share button in Safari’s toolbar.
install.iosStepAdd: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install.iosStepConfirm: Tap “Add”. Town Basket shows up with your other apps.
